products.title: Acer PE270K L1 27" 4K LCD Monitor
products.description: The Acer PE270K L1 is a 27-inch 4K UHD LCD monitor designed for high-performance workflows. It features a brightness of 400 nits and a fast 4ms response time to reduce blur and ghosting. The monitor offers versatile connectivity with USB Type-C (supporting data, video, and power), HDMI 2.1, and DisplayPort 1.4. Its 16:9 widescreen aspect ratio and AI-powered optimization enhance multitasking and productivity. The physical design includes a silver and black finish with a height-adjustable and swivel stand, as well as built-in 4W speakers.

products.title: ColorPro VP2776T-4K Monitor
products.description: The ViewSonic ColorPro VP2776T-4K is a 27-inch 4K HDR monitor designed for professionals. It features a 16:9 IPS panel with 3840 x 2160 UHD resolution, providing crisp visuals and a wide 178° viewing angle. The monitor is Pantone validated and factory calibrated for high color accuracy (Delta <2), covering 98% of the DCI-P3 and 89% of the Adobe RGB color gamuts. It offers versatile connectivity with Thunderbolt 4, dual HDMI 2.1, and DisplayPort 1.4, including an integrated dock with a 2.5GbE Ethernet port and various USB ports. Additional features include VESA HDR400 certification, built-in 3W stereo speakers, and an ergonomic stand that supports height, tilt, swivel, and 90° rotation.

products.title: Viewsonic 4K Ultra HD LCD Monitor
products.description: This ViewSonic 27-inch IPS 4K Ultra HD LCD monitor (VA2756-4K-MHD) delivers sharp 3840 x 2160 resolution with a 75Hz refresh rate and a frameless, ultra-thin bezel design. Enjoy accurate color and consistent brightness from nearly any angle thanks to SuperClear IPS technology. Reduce eye fatigue with Flicker-Free technology and a Blue Light Filter, and choose from “Game,” “Movie,” “Web,” “Text,” and “Mono” preset modes for optimized viewing. With flexible connectivity, it supports HDMI, DisplayPort, and VGA inputs for laptops, PCs, and more. Anti-glare support and a VESA 100 x 100 mount add convenience for home or office setups.

products.title: Redragon 27" 4K Flat Gaming Monitor
products.description: The Redragon 27" 4K Flat Gaming Monitor is a high-performance display featuring a Fast IPS panel with Mini-LED technology and 2304 local dimming zones for stunning 4K UHD clarity and vibrant colors. products.title: ASUS VY27UQ 27" 16:9 4K Ultra HD IPS LED HDR Monitor
products.description: The ASUS VY27UQ is a 27-inch 4K HDR monitor designed for entry-level creative designers and editors. It features a 16:9 IPS panel with a 3840 x 2160 resolution and a 60 Hz refresh rate, ensuring high image detail and color accuracy. The monitor supports 1.07 billion colors and 99% of the sRGB color gamut, with a brightness of 350 nits and a 1000:1 static contrast ratio. To enhance the user experience, it includes Adaptive-Sync technology and a 5 ms (GtG) response time to reduce screen tearing. Eye care is prioritized with TUV Rheinland-certified Blue Light Filter and Flicker-Free technology. Additionally, it features an antibacterial ionic silver treatment on thin bezels and hot keys, dual 2W speakers, and multiple connectivity options including HDMI and DisplayPort.

products.title: KTC 27" 4K MiniLED Gaming Monitor M27P6
products.description: The KTC M27P6 is a 27-inch 4K UHD gaming monitor featuring advanced Mini LED backlight technology with 1152 local dimming zones for exceptional contrast and HDR 1400 brightness. It offers a unique dual-mode capability, allowing users to switch between 4K resolution at 160Hz and FHD resolution at 320Hz, catering to both visual quality and high-speed competitive gaming. The monitor uses a Fast IPS panel with a 1ms response time and supports a wide color gamut (99% sRGB, 98% DCI-P3). Connectivity is comprehensive with USB-C 65W power delivery, HDMI 2.1, DisplayPort 1.4, and integrated KVM functionality for managing multiple devices. The ergonomic stand supports tilt, swivel, height adjustment, and pivot, and it is VESA mount compatible.
